relations.label: avadhuti (7963) lineage predecessor of atiśa dīpaṃkaraśrījñāna (3745)
relations.zotero_refs:
[RCJ46BHM]: 337 also records the lineage of Madhyamaka from Jo bo Dīpaṃkara (ID:3745) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895): Nāga (ID:3720), Āryadeva (ID:3702), Candrakīrti (ID:3725), Rig pa'i khu byug che (*Vidyākokila) (ID:7788), (Rig pa'i khu byug) chung (i.e. a wa d+hu ti) (ID:7963), Jo bo Atisha (ID:3745), sTon pa chen po (i.e., 'Brom ston rGyal ba'i 'byung gnas) (ID:3827), sPyan snga ba (Tshul khrims 'bar) (ID:3830), Bya yul pa (ID:3915). Then from many unspecified bKa’ gdams pa masters to Lord sGam po pa (ID:4189). 

Alternatively, from Bo to ba (i.e. Po to ba) (ID:3829), Sha ra ba (ID:3869), to Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), and from him it is then the same as the first lineage of Nāropa (ID:5639) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895) (see [RCJ46BHM]: 329).
